lines.text: Making a short video usually means a timeline, a voice-over, an export, and a lot of waiting.
Reel Studio turns a script into a finished vertical video, on your own machine.
Paste a script in English, Hindi or Hinglish. The planner lays out scenes, characters, camera moves and sound, offline, in seconds.
Then edit it like a real video editor. A live preview that plays with the voice, a lane for every character, and an inspector for every detail.
No script? Build it by hand. Pick a background, cast characters, add objects, actions, sounds and words, one scene at a time, all from the library.
That library holds thirty-nine characters, seventy-two objects and twenty places, and you can add your own artwork.
Export a Full HD vertical video in about eighty seconds on a laptop. The same script and settings always give the same video, and nothing leaves your machine unless you choose it.
Reel Studio. Script in, video out. As a product, as a service, or as an engine inside your own platform.
